parameters.name: TemperatureHigh
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the internal temperature exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TemperatureLow
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the internal temperature is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: VccHigh
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the internal supply voltage exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: VccLow
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the internal supply voltage is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: TxBiasHigh
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the TX Bias current exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TxBiasLow
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the TX Bias current is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: TxPowerHigh
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the TX output power exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TxPowerLow
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the TX output power is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: RxPowerHigh
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the Received Power exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: RxPowerLow
parameters.description: Set to {{true}} when the Received Power is below the low alarm level.

object.description: This object contains the state of the SFP internal Diagnostic Alarms Flags {{bibref|SFF-8472|Table 9-17}}.
